title: Cherry Streusel Bars
changes_from_base: Shortbread base, cherry and cherry-jam filling and an oat-almond streusel in place of caramel and chocolate.
summary: Shortbread bars with a cherry and cherry-jam filling and an oat-almond streusel.
equipment: 23 x 33 cm metal baking tin, lined with a baking-paper sling

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Base
steps.text: Heat the oven to 190 °C (170 °C fan) and line the big tin. Pulse the flour, sugar and salt, then the cold butter, until like wet sand. Take out about 300 g and set aside.

steps.title: Prebake
steps.text: Spread the rest over the tin, press firmly and bake 16-18 min, turning halfway, until light golden.

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: Wipe the processor and pulse the cherries, jam, lemon juice, almond flavouring and pinch of salt until finely chopped.

steps.title: Streusel
steps.text: Toss the oats, almonds and brown sugar into the reserved crumbs and rub in the softened butter into small clumps.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Spread the filling over the base, scatter the streusel loosely and bake 22-25 min, until bubbling and golden.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool completely in the tin, about 2 h, before cutting into 24.

tips: Thaw and drain the cherries well.
Do not press the streusel into the filling.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Store airtight at room temperature for up to 4 days, or freeze for up to 2 months.
